; 3.0.6 - These are no longer user customizable as changing these may break the server functionality. [07/13/2009]
; 6 rounds per match, switch sides after 3, use OT to break ties (auto-switch randomly for OT), show Mission Pre-planning after switch
; iMaxRoundsPerMatch=${MaxRoundsPerMatch}
; iAutoSwitchSidesRound=${AutoSwitchSidesRound}
; bAllowOTRoundOnTies=${AllowOTRoundOnTies}

bAutoSwitchOnOTRoundRandomly=${AutoSwitchOnOTRoundRandomly}

						; to allow other players time to pick a side before being forced onto a team.

; Requires 1 player on a team to start (set to 0 to allow zero-sized teams which will let player join instantly)

; For MC based missions, always use kismet based rules for spawning (ignore spawning customization options)

; Defaults for Mission Controller mission options
sMissionType=defend
sMissionTourID=inf
sMissionSize=medium


; Teamspeak enable for server
bUseTS3VOIP=${UseTS3VOIP}

; Available codec values:

;*******************************************************
; Event/scoring system options
;*******************************************************
[AA3Baseline.AA_EventList]

; Event Simulator support.  If bSimulateinRealTime set then events are replayed at the same rate as originally recorded.
; If not set, then the fpSimulationDelayBetweenEvents time is used between every event (note setting this to a large value 
; could result in very slow playback during simulation).
; If bRealTimeDelayForFirstEvent (used only if bSimulateInRealTime is true) is set then the simulation pauses until the original
; time of the first event before starting event simulation.  If false, starts immediately after loading of the level.
bRealTimeDelayForFirstEvent=false
bSimulateInRealTime=true
fpSimulationDelayBetweenEvents=0.5
bDebugSimulationLoading=false
bDebugSimulationPlayback=true


; Under fire tracking - how long in seconds since last bullet buzz/wound will player be considered under fire
fpUnderFireDuration=20

; Distance enemy and friendly players must be within to be considered in the "surrounded" ratio (in UU, default about 50m)
fpSurroundedMaxDistance=2750

; Ratio of enemy players to friendly players player must be near to be considered "surrounded"
; (e.g. Enemy / Friendly (including player) >= ratio)
fpSurroundedEnemyToFriendlyRatio=2.0

; "pressed for time" - percentage of time left in round to be considered "pressed for time"
fpPFTRemainingTimePercent=0.85



; Event Debugging support
bDebugWeaponShotsFiredStats=false
bDebugWeaponShotsHitStats=false
bDebugROEEvents=false
bDebugStdEvents=false

; Event logging support (XML option generates simulator compatible XML file)
bLogXML=false
bLogText=false


; This is a list of predefined event types (See TDD for valid list).  It is only used when bUseSimulationEventList is # true and if used, ; will only simulate the events in this list.
bUseSimulationEventList=false
; asSimulationEventList${0}=

; ROE forgiveness options (near "max" distance is set to @25 meters, using 55UU/m and is set in UU)
; Note that for release this should probably be moved to the default properties.
fpROEForgivenessTestFrequency=1.0
fpROEViolationNearMaxDistance=1375
fpMaxROEAutoKick=250

; Under Fire duration (how long player can go without being buzzed before they are no longer considered under fire)
; Note that for release this should probably be moved to the default properties.
fpUnderFireDuration=20.0



[AA3Baseline.AA_PlayerController]

; MBS Browser Options
;*************************************


; Client support for MBS

; IP of MBS Server
sMBSServerIPAddress=mbs.aa3.americasarmy.com 

; Port of MBS Server
iMBSServerPort=3040

;LAN Browser Client listener port (must be different from iMBSLANServerListenerPort).
iLANServerListenerPort=9001


;*************************************
; Game Server MBS options
;*************************************
[AA3Baseline.AA_ServerAuthorization]
bDisableMBSUpdatingMessage=true

; IP of auth server
sAuthHostServerIPAddress=auth.aa3.americasarmy.com 

; IP of MBS server for authorized/official servers
sMBSServerIPAddress=mbs.aa3.americasarmy.com

; Port of MBS Server
iMBSServerPort=3040

;This is used when your server is behind a firewall and you want to allow incoming connections via 
;the MBS browser.  Set this value to your cable or DSL modem's IP address.  Leave blank to use
;the game server IP used to authorize the server.
; sMBSExternalGameServerIP=

; This is the LAN server IP Address if a LAN server is being used.  If this isn't used the sMBSExternalGameServerIP is 
; tested and if valid, used.  If that isn't valid then the server defaults to the sAuthServerIPAddress (which can be
; set on the command line.  Generally for any LAN (?LAN on command line) should set this value here.
;sMBSLANGameServerIP=

; Base Port to use for querying game server from game clients and MBS for MBS information (must be open in firewall)
; The iMBSServerQueryPortRange field specifies how many sequential ports will be used by MBS.
iMBSBaseGameServerQueryPort=39300

; How many sequential ports queries will be accepted on?  Maybe...have to ask Josh
iMBSServerQueryPortRange=39400

;LAN Browser server port to listen on
iMBSLANServerListenerPort=9000

bAuthAlwaysAllowUserGroup=true



;*************************************
; ATS and Auth Options
;*************************************

; IP and port of game server (reported to auth & MBS so must be cable/dsl modem and not local LAN IP)
; This can be set with the server command line "?AuthServerIP=x.x.x.x" and it will override this INI value.
; Note the port must match the BaseEngine.ini's ${URL} port value.
sAuthServerIPAddress=${IPAddress}
iAuthServerGamePort=8777

sServerOwnerName=${ServerOwnerName}
